steps.text: Start with the entire list; -1 means no match has been found.
Repeat while low is at most high.
Choose the middle index using integer division.
Check whether scores[mid] is at least target.
Remember this match, but keep searching left for an earlier duplicate.
Discard the middle and everything to its right.
Discard the middle and everything to its left.
Return the earliest matching index, or -1.
